verification.notes: Sony and the Michael Jackson Estate jointly announced a negotiated 2016 sale of the Estate remaining 50 percent interest in Sony ATV for 750 million dollars. The Estate received substantial consideration and retained other Jackson publishing rights. That primary transaction record directly contradicts the assertion that the estate and Beatles catalog were stolen after his death.

sources.title: Sony and Jackson Estate Announce Closing of Sony Purchase of Remaining Sony ATV Interest
sources.relevance: Primary joint announcement documents a paid, negotiated purchase from the Estate rather than a theft.

records.text: Candace Owens said Michael Jackson had specifically identified Jewish people in Hollywood whom he said were manipulating his life.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He specifically laid out the Jews in Hollywood that were toying with his life, similar to what Kanye (Kanye West) said when he tweeted that, but there were specific Jews in his life that were doing things to him.

verification.notes: Reliable reporting confirms Jackson used anti-Jewish slurs in a 1995 song and that a disputed 2005 voicemail attributed to him blamed Jews collectively for financial exploitation. The reviewed sources do not establish the more specific claim that he publicly identified named Jewish individuals in Hollywood who were manipulating his life. Related generalized remarks are documented, but the exact named-individual claim remains unsupported.

records.text: Candace Owens said one reason the Daily Wire fired her was that she suggested Michael Jackson might have been telling the truth.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: One of the reasons I was fired from Daily Wire was for suggesting that Michael Jackson could have been telling the truth and that maybe it's time to listen.

verification.notes: Owens has publicly said the Michael Jackson or Hollywood-gang segment was one reason for her departure, and contemporaneous coverage notes that segment as part of a broader controversy. Daily Wire public announcement only said the relationship ended and did not disclose a specific cause. The exact internal reason therefore cannot be independently established from public evidence.

records.text: Owens said one specific reason The Daily Wire gave for firing her was that she had suggested there could be a Jewish mafia in Hollywood while covering Michael Jackson's death.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What kind of gym trainer writes that kind of stuff? And I have to tell you guys, and this is not even a joke, one of the reasons among many that I was fired from the Daily Wire, a specific reason that they listed was I suggested that there could be a Jewish mafia in Hollywood in my coverage of Michael Jackson's death.

verification.notes: The March 8, 2024 Daily Wire segment did connect Michael Jackson to Owens's suggestion of a small Jewish gang in Hollywood, and contemporaneous reporting places that segment immediately before her departure amid disputes over alleged antisemitism. However, Daily Wire did not publicly release the internal list of specific termination reasons, so the claim that this was an expressly enumerated reason rests on Owens's account.
